findings.title: Concurrent delete still NPEs in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: File GroupAdapter.java line 256 (and lines 262, 268) dereferences modelSupplier.get() without a null check, while the fix on getSubGroupsCount in the same file acknowledges getGroupById can return null when the group was concurrently deleted. If the group is deleted between cache lookup and DB lookup, modelSupplier.get() returns null and these three getSubGroupsStream variants throw NullPointerException, leaving the same 500-error race the PR claims to fix.

findings.title: Reader thread never joined before assertion
findings.body: File GroupTest.java line 139 starts a background reader thread and line 157 asserts on caughtExceptions immediately after deletedAll.set(true) without joining the thread. A request already in flight can fail after the assertion, so failures are missed and the test can falsely pass, and the thread can outlive the test and interfere with later tests. If the delete loop throws, deletedAll is never set and the tight polling loop spins forever.
